description: This is a Flutter widget source file defining the HomeRootScreen screen, including state management, UI layout, and interaction logic for the home page of an app.

classes.name: HomeRootScreen
classes.description: A Flutter StatelessWidget that builds the home screen, managing different UI states such as loading, error, empty, and displaying content rails with user interactions.

classes.name: _HomeLoading
classes.description: A placeholder widget showing skeleton loaders while the home content is loading.

classes.name: _HomeError
classes.description: Displays an error message with a retry button when loading the home data fails.

classes.name: _HomeEmpty
classes.description: Shows a message indicating no content is available and offers a reload button.

classes.name: _ContinueWatchingEmpty
classes.description: Displays a placeholder encouraging users to start watching content to populate the 'Continue Watching' section.

methods.name: build
methods.description: Builds the widget tree for the HomeRootScreen, handling different data loading states and rendering the appropriate UI components.

methods.name: _formatPosition
methods.description: Converts a position in seconds into a human-readable string format (e.g., '2m 05s').
